It earned Rs 2.10 crore on day 58 from 1,339 screens, down 6.7%. After a slow Rs 25 lakh start, it has grossed Rs 379.96 crore in India and Rs 419.46 crore worldwide.

title: Vijay Deverakonda mourn veteran filmmaker Singeetham Srinivasa Rao
description: Singeetham Srinivasa Rao, a veteran filmmaker, has passed away at the age of 94. He was known for his inventive storytelling across multiple Indian film industries. Celebrities like Vijay Deverakonda and Chiranjeevi have expressed their condolences and shared memories. His final film, 'Sing Geetham', showcased his passion for cinema and creativity at an advanced age. Singeetham's legacy includes significant contributions to various regional film industries in India.

title: Ranvir Shorey says he lost a big film for being 'too vocal' and 'anti-govt'
description: Ranvir Shorey has revealed that he was allegedly rejected from a big-banner film after being labelled “anti-govt,” “too vocal” and “potentially controversial.” The actor said a trusted source finally confirmed what he had long suspected and described the experience as disheartening. Shorey, known for his outspoken social media presence and acclaimed performances, received support from several users after sharing the revelation. He is currently associated with projects including Khosla Ka Ghosla 2 and other upcoming titles.

title: Chiranjeevi condemns AI-morphed video targeting women, seeks dedicated support cell
description: Chiranjeevi spoke out against the growing prevalence of artificial intelligence being misused to create disrespectful videos aimed at women. He highlighted the urgent need for action within the film industry and called for legal measures against the offenders. Jr NTR echoed this sentiment, voicing his outrage and intentions to take legal steps against those responsible. Vijay Deverakonda described the act as akin to digital sexual assault, demanding tougher legal penalties.

title: Vedika explains why Musafir Cafe ending changed
description: Vedika Pinto, who stars as Sudha Tripathi in Musafir Café, rose to fame with Ritviz's Liggi video before moving into films. She told Free Press Journal she did endless auditions from 2017 to 2020. Vedika also explained her name's meaning and said exciting projects await. The series is directed by Ruchir Arun.

title: Hirata Runa passes away at 8; family remembers her as an ‘eternal idol’
description: The beloved eight-year-old pop star Hirata Runa has sadly passed away due to myocarditis linked to influenza complications, according to her agency, DIANNA Project. The family has requested privacy as they navigate this heartbreaking loss. Runa recently electrified her fans with performances, etching her charm into their hearts. Remembered fondly as an eternal idol, her family conducted a private funeral ceremony to celebrate her life and legacy.

title: Chad Lowe’s daughter Mabel remembers late sister Fiona in emotional tribute
description: Chad Lowe's family is heartbroken over the tragic loss of their daughter Fiona. Mabel opened up on social media, sharing precious childhood moments and a loving tribute for Fiona. Remembered for her joyful spirit and passion for dance, the family asks for privacy during this difficult time while also highlighting Fiona's battle. They shared mental health resources for anyone who may need support.

title: ‘Verity’ ending explained: The truth behind the manuscript
description: Anne Hathaway stars as Verity Crawford, who is paralyzed after an accident, while Dakota Johnson plays Lowen Ashleigh, hired to finish Verity's book series. Lowen discovers a manuscript revealing Verity's dark past and her potential guilt in a tragic incident involving her children. After questioning Verity's condition, she learns shocking truths that complicate her feelings for Jeremy, Verity's husband.

title: Pedro Pascal reveals why learning cello for ‘Behemoth!’ was so difficult
description: In preparation for his role in 'Behemoth!', Pedro Pascal embraced the challenge of learning the cello within a week. He found the experience both demanding and gratifying, describing it as one of the toughest creative endeavors he's ever faced. To bond with the instrument, he carried the cello around during rehearsals. The film premiered at the New York Film Festival and is set to hit US theatres in December.

title: John Leguizamo praises Matt Damon as ‘the coolest, funniest, realest dude’
description: At a recent event in Beverly Hills, John Leguizamo praised Matt Damon, highlighting his enjoyable working style filled with humor and generosity. They are set to collaborate again on a project directed by the Daniels. Reflecting on their prior work together, 'The Odyssey', Leguizamo expressed hope for its recognition in awards circuits and is eager to explore future collaborations with Damon.

title: Michael J. Fox’s Parkinson’s advocacy earns him Canada’s highest honour
description: Michael J. Fox was honored as a Companion of the Order of Canada for his significant contributions. His work in Parkinson's advocacy began after being diagnosed with the disease in 1991. Fox founded the Michael J. Fox Foundation, which has funded over $3 billion for Parkinson's research. He expressed his deep connection to Canada and appreciation for the honor during the ceremony.

title: 'I won't even get half of this Rs 300 crore': Fahadh on 'BKU'
description: Fahadh Faasil shared his happiness about the gross collection of 'Bethlehem Kudumba Unit', which surpassed Rs 300 crore. He clarified that these figures are not reflective of individual earnings, emphasizing collective success. The film features a memorable re-creation scene involving Mamitha Baiju that stood out for him. 'Bethlehem Kudumba Unit' released during Onam and received positive audience reactions. The film has since started streaming after a successful theatrical run.

title: Mammootty praises Karthik Subbaraj's 'Dorothy'
description: Karthik Subbaraj's 'Dorothy' has garnered favorable reviews and decent box office earnings since its release. The film features Keerthy Suresh, Sananth, and Rishikanth and premiered at the Toronto International Film Festival. Mammootty has appreciated the film and the efforts of its cast and crew. As of now, 'Dorothy' has grossed Rs 10.61 crore worldwide and Rs 9.15 crore net in India.

title: Drishyam 3 Box Office Day 2: Ajay thriller races past Rs 100cr
description: Ajay Devgn's Drishyam 3 – The Conclusion earned Rs 53.50 crore on Saturday, down 13.7% from Friday, per Sacnilk. The Abhishek Pathak thriller crossed Rs 100 crore in two days, with Rs 115.50 crore in India and Rs 177.10 crore worldwide. It is expected to pass Rs 150 crore by Sunday.

title: KATSEYE's Lara Raj breaks silence on her viral kumkum look
description: At Paris Fashion Week, Lara Raj turned heads by blending Indian cultural motifs with her Loewe dress. Adorning herself with traditional jewellery and kumkum, she paid homage to her Bollywood idol Rekha and honored her mother. This fusion not only highlighted her Indian heritage but also reflected her deep pride in showcasing the beauty of her culture on such a prestigious global platform.

title: 'Mandaadi' BO day 24 vs 'Baththa'
description: Soori's film 'Mandaadi' experienced an increase in box office collections, reaching Rs 99.92 cr in India net. This growth comes after the film earned Rs 2.97 cr on its 24th day. The movie's India gross collection has climbed to Rs 116.48 cr while its worldwide gross stands at Rs 134.18 cr. Additionally, Vijay Sethupathi's 'Baththa' debuted and has collected Rs 6.95 cr in India net.

title: 'Avengers: Endgame Encore' BO day 9
description: Since its recent re-release, Avengers: Endgame has raked in a notable Rs 34.41 crore net in India. Notably, the English version played a substantial role, contributing more than Rs 24 crore. The addition of Hindi, Telugu, and Tamil versions has further boosted the total earnings, generating excitement among fans for the upcoming Avengers: Doomsday film and offering a perfect opportunity to relive the Infinity Saga on the big screen.

title: Sequels confirmed For Ikka, Shaque: Siddharth says new seasons in works
description: Siddharth P Malhotra has confirmed sequels to his hit OTT projects, 'Ikka' and 'Shaque'. Both have performed strongly, and 'Shaque' will return with a fresh story in Season 2. 'Ikka', starring Sunny Deol, is a courtroom drama, while 'Shaque' follows Parineeti Chopra's search for her missing daughter.

title: 'Sigma' BO day 2: Film earns Rs 1.50 cr
description: On October 3, Jason Sanjay's directorial debut 'Sigma' saw a reduction in box office figures, earning Rs 1.50 crore net on its second day. After two days, the cumulative earnings reached Rs 3.85 crore in India, with the Tamil version showing a greater impact than its Telugu counterpart. 'Sigma' narrates the story of a librarian faced with financial dilemmas and the complexities of criminal connections.

title: Emma Roberts shares romantic wedding moments with Cody John
description: Emma Roberts recently revealed beautiful photos from her wedding with Cody John held in July 2026. The couple exchanged vows at John's family estate in Sun Valley, Idaho, with Roberts' son playing a special role. Roberts wore a vintage-inspired Monique Lhuillier gown, while John opted for a classic black tuxedo. Their relationship began in May 2022, leading to an engagement announcement in July 2024.
